description: NaMgLaTeO₆ is Pb (Zr_0.50 Ti_0.48) O_3-derived structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/m space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.86 Å. Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent TeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 4-30°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.01-2.22 Å. La is bonded in a 11-coordinate geometry to eleven O atoms. There are a spread of La-O bond distances ranging from 2.44-2.94 Å. Te is bonded to six O atoms to form TeO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 4-30°. There are a spread of Te-O bond distances ranging from 1.88-2.02 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Mg, three equivalent La, and one Te atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na, one Mg, and one Te atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Mg, two equivalent La, and one Te atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Mg, two equivalent La, and one Te atom.
